description:
Two women's luxury fragrance/beauty accessories, 1940s-50s vintage, featuring a Lanvin gold-plated cylindrical 1/8 fl. oz. perfume vial of Arpege, designed by Cartier and presented in its original blue Lanvin fitted box, together with an elegant mother-of-pearl mirrored compact.
The Lanvin piece has a finely ribbed center section with geometric black enamel-style detailing at each end. The presentation case is marked “LANVIN” inside the lid and “Designed by Cartier” on the fitted interior, making it an especially interesting piece of designer vanity memorabilia.
Accompanying it is a rectangular mother-of-pearl mirrored compact, constructed with geometric panels of luminous white iridescent shell and finished with gold-tone metal edging and clasp.
Good pre-owned condition. The perfume vial still contains some original Arpege perfume. The compact still contains powder but shows some damage/wear to the mother-of-pearl surface and metalwork. Please see photos for overall condition, measurements, and additional details.

We do our best to have items shipped within 7 business days from the date of payment; we are not open on weekends. We are limited to the carriers’ rules and regulations when shipping an order. Minimum shipment weight is 1 lb. Items weighing less than 1 lb. will be calculated at the 1 lb. rate.

Combined Orders:
Multiple items can be combined PRIOR TO the checkout process provided that the payment deadline has not expired on any of the items that you are combining to create the order, and that the combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds. Combined shipping must be requested by the customer prior to payment; it is not automatically allowed. Once an item has been paid for, it is no longer eligible for combined shipping. We reserve the right to deny combination of certain items.
Insurance:
Buyer must email a request for insurance prior to making payment. Insurance cannot be added by the buyer during the payment process. An e-mail must be sent to us and we will then edit the order total for you.
We apologize, but if your package is damaged or lost we will not be able to issue a refund unless your package was insured. We strongly recommend insurance on all breakable items. Photos will be required before a refund will be considered.
Handling Fee:
A minimum of $3.00 handling fee will appear at checkout and applies to all purchases regardless of delivery method or pick up. Our handling fee is a set fee and cannot be adjusted. (Certain items that are very fragile, irregularly shaped, and/or heavy may be subject to an increased handling fee.) These fees, along with your purchase, help to support our Goodwill mission.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
